title: Revivalists — Rev. R. B. Howerton Jr. and Rev. Harold K. Davis
text: REVIVALISTS—Rev. R. B. Howerton, Jr., Methodist pastor at Howe, (left) and Rev. Harold K. Davis, pastor of the Savoy Methodist Church, will conduct a revival starting today at the Marvin Methodist Church, four miles east of Whitewright. The revival will continue through the week with services each night at 7:45 o'clock.
notes: Two portrait photographs side by side: Rev. R. B. Howerton Jr. on left, Rev. Harold K. Davis on right.
